hospitals.policy_source: Grady Health System Financial Assistance Program Policy, CFO adoption / last update March 20, 2026
hospitals.residency_rule: Fulton County or DeKalb County residents (primary). Out-of-county patients may qualify only for emergency services, related inpatient admissions, and related post-discharge care.
hospitals.discount_tiers_notes: No published numerical discount or copayment schedule exists in the FAP. The policy states that patients ≤ 400% FPL are eligible for assistance and that sliding-scale discounts or full charity care are applied. Exact patient responsibility (copay) is determined only after income verification by a financial counselor and depends on household size, verified income, and type of care.
hospitals.how_to_get_exact_amount: Patient must speak directly with a Grady financial counselor. Call 404-616-6920 (option 1), Mon–Fri 7:00 a.m.–3:30 p.m., or apply via MyChart / mail / fax.
hospitals.notes: Presumptive eligibility is run automatically at registration and again at billing using third-party software. Medicaid-approved patients are considered qualified. Unhoused patients (HUD definition) may receive assistance with no copayment. Application period is 240 days from first post-discharge statement.

contact.mail: Grady Memorial Hospital, 80 Jesse Hill Jr. Dr. SE, PO Box 26071, Atlanta, GA 30303, Attn: Financial Assistance Program – Mail-In Packets
